نجترم (form VIII)
# نَجْتَرِمُ (najtarimu) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ri.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# نُجْتَرَمُ (nujtaramu) /nud͡ʒ.ta.ra.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# نَجْتَرِمَ (najtarima) /nad͡ʒ.ta.ri.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَرَمَ (ijtarama)
# نُجْتَرَمَ (nujtarama) /nud͡ʒ.ta.
